layout: frame-major, then row-major (row 0 = lat +90), per cell: black_carbon,dust,sea_salt,sulfate (mix 0-255, sums ~255), strength (0-255)
source: NASA SVS 5572 GEOS aerosols, 1 Aug - 14 Sep 2024, sampled every 2 s of video
note: strength = relative colour brightness, not physical optical depth; frame k is about day k*1.22 (approximate)
